title: Admin JSON reads publish prepared cross-account data and metadata after administrator withdrawal commits
originalResult: An actual authenticated Gateway user-directory read reaches its service barrier. Another administrator remains active; a committed membership demotion is confirmed before release. The request still returned200and three account records. No Runtime or model is started.
correction: A request-owned awaited JSON responder resolves the authenticated actor again after data preparation. Organization, membership, account, deletion, administrator role and required password eligibility precede data plus sensitive headers. Known withdrawal returns403 and unavailable lookup returns503; committed mutations retain their service result. The router and its Runtime-management delegate both use the responder, including node-health JSON and archive JSON export.

postgres17ActualGateway.reasonForAdapters: Only the HTTP publication path is accepted for these three external read services; their data preparation is controlled and does not establish physical node-content, Runtime allocation or archive bytes acceptance.

priorPolicyIntegration.fixtureChange: Concurrent withdrawal now holds its transaction uncommitted through the authorized response; the real UPDATE is first proven blocked by the policy reader. This preserves the database lock-order proof while the final JSON publisher checks only committed eligibility.
